# Vendored NixFlix plugin modules

These files are verbatim copies from `kiriwalawren/nixflix` revision
`b668fa4159b9a294efd6e49ea3b889ecdd77e809`, matching the current `flake.lock`.
`provenance.json` records each original repository path and SHA-256 digest.

Do not edit these copies as local adaptations. Place maintained replacements in
`../compatibility/` or `../plugins/`, then update the source assembly explicitly.
The source adapter copies only `vendor/modules/` into the patched source tree.
Generated Navidrome definitions and maintained updater scripts live in
`../plugins/`, separately from these upstream copies.
